summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K announcing exchange offers and consent solicitations in connection with its acquisition of Qorvo. Skyworks commenced offers to exchange any and all of Qorvo's 4.375% Senior Notes due 2029 for up to $850M of new Skyworks notes and Qorvo's 3.375% Senior Notes due 2031 for up to $700M of new Skyworks notes. The offers are subject to conditions including completion of the merger, where Qorvo will merge into a Skyworks subsidiary. No price per share or premium is disclosed; the filing focuses on debt exchange mechanics. Watch for merger closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
